Shaded relief of the world, from Natural Earth (naturalearthdata.com), 1:50m rasters
SR_50M (shaded relief, grey) and GRAY_50M_SR_OB (grey earth with shaded relief and ocean bottom).
Natural Earth data is in the public domain. Equirectangular (plate carree), -180..180, 90..-90.
Converted to JPEG at 10800x5400 and 4096x2048 for design 2, 2026-10-02.
